label: Minimum above-ground density
description: Minimum above ground density of macrophyte

label: Drag coefficient constant
description: Constant relating macrophyte density to drag coefficient

label: Below-ground biomass fraction
description: Fraction of primary production apportioned to below-ground biomass

label: Plant density-coverage constant
description: Omega constant relating plant density to effective area of coverage

label: Carbon to chlorophyll ratio
description: Internal C:Chl-a ratio of the plant leaves

label: Temperature limitation method
description: Specifies temperature limitation function of growth (0 = no temperature limitation, 1 = CAEDYM style)

label: Growth temperature scaling
description: Arrhenius temperature scaling for growth function

label: Light model
description: Type of light response function (0 = no photoinhibition, 1 = photoinhibition)

label: Light half-saturation constant
description: Half saturation constant for light limitation of growth (used if lightModel=0)

label: Exudation fraction
description: Fraction of primary production lost to exudation

label: Respiration temperature scaling
description: Arrhenius temperature scaling factor for respiration

label: Salinity limitation at S_maxsp
description: Salinity limitation value at maximum salinity S_maxsp
